reason: An observed L02 development failure supplied an already-composed target sentence as source facts before inviting the author to practise that sentence. Sequence alone did not preserve the chosen writing operation.

case.task: Help me practise replacing vague praise with a specific result. Give me the source facts and let me attempt a sentence before showing an answer.
case.before: The results were very, very good.
source_notes: The model correctly classified 80 of 100 cases.
No comparator, baseline or additional outcome was supplied.

inspected_evidence.parent_reported_failure: The model correctly classified 80 of 100 cases. No baseline... followed by an invitation to rewrite.
inspected_evidence.scope: Only raw L02 and the parent-quoted failure were inspected for this fix; unrelated paired outputs were not read.

scope: Four conditional learning instructions only. Ordinary writing gains no practice burden; requested worked solutions remain direct. Scripts, tests, metadata versions and all other canonical content unchanged.

files.before_wording: when attempt-first practice is requested, let the author attempt first. Give a requested worked solution directly
files.after_wording: when attempt-first practice is requested, let the author attempt first. In chosen practice, supply necessary facts and constraints without completing the writing move being practised, even in a facts preface. Give a requested worked solution directly

Neither accepting an edit nor repeating a phrase proves learning or transfer.
